content.caseIdentity: Additional District Magistrate, Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla, (1976) 2 SCC 521; AIR 1976 SC 1207
content.facts: During the 1975 Emergency, detenus challenged detention through habeas corpus proceedings and the Court considered the effect of the Presidential order under Article 359(1).
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether habeas corpus could be maintained during the relevant Presidential order.
Whether suspension of enforcement of Article 21 barred judicial examination of detention.
content.ratioDecidendi: The majority held that the relevant Article 359(1) order barred enforcement of the suspended fundamental right through habeas corpus during the specified period; Justice H.R. Khanna dissented.
content.holding: By majority, habeas corpus relief was held unavailable for enforcement of the suspended right during the relevant Emergency. The majority position was later rejected in subsequent constitutional jurisprudence.
content.relevance: Landmark Emergency-era habeas corpus decision concerning Articles 21 and 359.
